parameters.note: El Dorado Forebay is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

parameters.description: El Dorado Forebay (Forebay Reservoir) is an El Dorado Irrigation District day-use recreation area open to the public from dawn until dusk; it is a no-body-contact reservoir — no swimming or wading, and no domestic animals in the water.

candidates.summary: Day-use area open dawn until dusk; no swimming or wading (no-body-contact reservoir)

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists El Dorado Forebay (Region 2, El Dorado Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of January-April & October-December (this entry covers the January-April window). This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
